# Fate UI v0.8.10-beta3

Fixes the multi-folder sidebar so switching folders never blanks another folder's session list, collapsed folders stay quiet, and browsing never spawns agents.

## Multi-folder sidebar fixes

- Switching folders no longer makes another folder flash "Scanning sessions…" then "No sessions yet". The folder you just left keeps showing the sessions it had, then reconciles from disk in the background.
- A background disk read can no longer replace a visible session list with an empty result, so a folder you can see stays populated.
- Collapsed folders no longer pop out session rows. They show only their count chip; expand a folder to see its sessions.
- Focusing a folder loads session titles from disk without spawning a Pi agent. The agent starts only when you open a session in that folder, and idles out after the grace period.
- A folder focused without a running agent now reads "No agent running — pick a session" instead of the alarming "Runtime unavailable".

## Compatibility and installers

No migration is needed. Existing projects, Pi sessions, settings, themes, and folder history are unchanged.

GitHub Actions builds and tests this release on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64. The prerelease contains installers plus `SHA256SUMS`:

- Windows x64: NSIS `.exe`
- macOS arm64 and x64: `.dmg` and `.pkg`
- Linux x64: `.AppImage` and `.deb`

Public beta installers remain unsigned. Windows SmartScreen or macOS Gatekeeper may show an unknown-publisher warning. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.
